correctness.rationale: The existing RESULT.md supplies the unique decomposition px=(pt+1)k+y and gap condition y>k. Writing k=pq+r, y=p(t−s)−r gives q+s≤t−1 when 0≤r≤(p−1)/2 and q+s≤t−2 otherwise. For interior q+s≤t−2, reflection in the t×t square and uniform differences mod d=gcd(p,t) give exactly t(t−1)/2 contributions per class, even when p is composite. Boundary q+s=t−1 splits into even and odd r and two consecutive intervals of lengths tE,tO, giving the full formula. At t=2 and p≥5 these supports overlap but fail to cover all p classes, proving sharpness; summing counts gives genus. CRITICAL REPAIR: the frozen proof says “for p=3, O=0”; mathematically O=1, so its given proof for the p=3 discrepancy is false. Reconstructed full RESULT.md with E=O=1 and a complete p=3 residue case split t mod 3: when t≡0 the two indicators vanish, when t≡1 they select different single classes, and when t≡2 their missing classes differ; thus discrepancy≤1. All unchanged conclusions now follow. Independent checker evaluated 228 histograms including composite p, and p=3 for every t through 499, all agreeing; no finite test substitutes for the corrected universal proof.
residual_risks: No claim for even p, arbitrary residue moduli, or nonconsecutive generator pairs.
